# Which booking requests should you accept?

> Paste your confirmed bookings and pending requests and get the exact set of requests to accept for the highest income, counting turnover cost and the dead gap nights a short stay leaves behind. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
